items.headline: Henley's Sixth PGA Win
items.text: Russell Henley won the 2026 Charles Schwab Challenge for his sixth PGA Tour victory.

items.headline: LSU's NCAA Rally
items.text: LSU shot 18-under 270 on Sunday to jump from T27 to T12 at the NCAA Championship, but still sits two shots outside the top-eight match-play cut with one stroke-play round left.
